title: Supervisor v2: prompt-kind primitives (taxonomy) before triage?
why: User wants explicit kinds (smalltalk, research, task, planning, multi-intent split). Need product agreement before MAST-79+ routing changes.

decision.rationale: Phased ingest before triage: classify prompt kinds and detect compound multi-intent; decompose to sub-intents with confidence gates; map each sub-intent to existing answer/research/delegate branches. Fan-out on ledger only when high-confidence; Assistant remains the only user-facing voice (MAST-85). Avoid MAST-97 big-bang until golden eval proves taxonomy.
